rules.delete: No hard delete; ON DELETE/UPDATE RESTRICT; archive preserves history
rules.money: Exact PostgreSQL NUMERIC/Prisma Decimal; canonical decimal string on wire; never binary float; currency required when purchaseCost is present; no default currency or FX conversion
rules.supplier: Supplier is an external counterparty and is not SellerLegalEntity; no automatic name/identifier merge; tax-id uniqueness awaits OD-007A-01
rules.offerRevision: Every accepted content edit appends an immutable complete revision; currentRevisionId points to latest revision; source facts are nullable and never inferred

identity.brandId: Explicit FK to an existing ACTIVE R1-004 Brand; not inferred from text
identity.normalization: Same frozen R1-004 normalization: Unicode NFC and trim only outer U+0020; preserve case, internal whitespace, punctuation and hyphens; compare text with PostgreSQL COLLATE C
identity.unknownModification: UNKNOWN never matches NULL CatalogProduct.modification; CONFIRMED_NONE is an explicit human statement and may match NULL
identity.automaticMatch: Exact candidate only; no name similarity, supplierPartNumber substitution, analogues or auto-association

rules.matchProposal: PENDING -> APPROVED|REJECTED; decision is terminal; an approved proposal is historical and only the SupplierOffer.currentMatchProposalId pointer identifies selected association
rules.currentMatch: Effective only while current offer and CatalogProduct tuples both still equal the approved identity snapshots; otherwise derived REVIEW_REQUIRED and never usable for costing
rules.freshness: Explicit expiresAt wins; otherwise sourceObservedAt ?? recordedAt plus owner-approved configured window; no configured window means UNKNOWN
rules.concurrency: Root/proposal expectedVersion compare-and-swap; offer/product rows locked and identity revalidated in same transaction as decision and success AuditEvent
rules.audit: Success domain mutation and AuditEvent share one PostgreSQL transaction; audit payload excludes raw contact, note, source URL, purchase amount, credentials and request body
rules.visibility: Staff-only endpoints and no-store responses; no supplier fields or cost in Public DTOs

fields.currentRevisionId: uuid NOT NULL; composite FK (currentRevisionId, Supplier.id) -> SupplierRevision(id, supplierId), DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED

checks: current root profile fields equal current SupplierRevision under deferred transaction guard
tax-identifier jurisdiction/uniqueness is subject to OD-007A-01
Supplier.deletePolicy: No hard delete; archived records remain readable by permission

SupplierRevision.immutability: Append-only complete profile snapshots; no UPDATE/DELETE after transaction commit

fields.currentRevisionId: uuid NOT NULL; composite FK (currentRevisionId, SupplierOffer.id) -> SupplierOfferRevision(id, offerId), DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
fields.currentMatchProposalId: uuid NULL; composite FK (currentMatchProposalId, SupplierOffer.id) -> ProductMatchProposal(id, offerId), DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED

SupplierOffer.deletePolicy: No hard delete; archive keeps revisions, matches and audit; no unique supplier/product/part-number constraint

fields.sourceUrl: varchar(2048) NULL; http(s) only; never fetched by server

checks: non-null purchaseCost requires non-null currency; currency can be present without cost
CONFIRMED_NONE and UNKNOWN require modification NULL
SupplierOfferRevision.immutability: Append-only; no UPDATE/DELETE after transaction commit

fields.offerRevisionId: uuid composite FK SupplierOfferRevision(id, offerId) RESTRICT
fields.offerIdentitySnapshot: jsonb with brandId, manufacturerName, originalPartNumber, modification, modificationEvidence
fields.productIdentitySnapshot: jsonb with brandId, manufacturerName, originalPartNumber, modification

ProductMatchProposal.deletePolicy: Append-only decision history; no delete or reversal; a replacement approved proposal moves the offer current pointer
